fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) recorded Q3 data center revenue of $8.5B, up 97% year-over-year, but the software gap due to Nvidia's CUDA advantage is noted as the most significant issue.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD's total company revenue grew 45% to $13.4B, but is roughly 1/9 the size of Nvidia's, with Nvidia maintaining a dominant leadership position in technology and market share to date.
